$comment: Ice shield idle sub-program. The source meshes are separate reusable assets in blender/assets/vfx/ice_shield/; this manifest describes only the rendered gameplay layers.
name: Ice Shield - Idle
description: A sparse frostglass barrier around the actor: a translucent faceted shell, one continuous arch rim, and a single crown shard. No particle swarm.
author: vfx-pipeline

sprite.$comment: Render at 512px, then pack_sheets downsamples to the 128px gameplay cell.

layers.note: One linked frost-glass canopy with an open lower-front actor window, procedural fracture variation, and a subtle breathing loop.
One linked continuous mesh arch, with a bright near edge and quieter far edge; no disconnected beads.
One linked crown shard with a restrained slow tilt and pulse.
